create_agent_mcp: create an Agent instance with a model, MCP servers, and custom system prompt for inference
run_agent_conversation: run the Agent with user input and stream chat completion responses through tool-using turns
load_agent_tools: load MCP server tools into the Agent by connecting to stdio or SSE server configurations
abort_agent_run: abort a running Agent loop using an asyncio.Event to stop inference mid-execution
test_agent_turns: test the Agent's multi-turn tool-calling loop with exit conditions and turn limits
